title: EvidenceItem
description: Standard evidence model tying an extracted data fact directly back to source document coordinates, page, confidence, and extraction method.

field_name.description: Identifier name of the extracted semantic field.

raw_value.description: Raw, unparsed string or value exactly as observed in OCR or document pixels.

normalized_value.description: Normalized value used for deterministic downstream computation (ISO date, number, uppercase enum, etc).

confidence.description: Confidence score of the OCR/extraction step between 0.0 and 1.0.

document_id.description: Unique identifier of the source document asset in storage.

document_type.description: Classified type of the source document.

page_number.description: 1-indexed page number where the evidence is located.

bbox.description: Bounding box coordinates [x1, y1, x2, y2] representing the bounding rectangle.

extraction_method.description: Method used to extract this field.
